name: Hinin Performer
body:
Your parents were constantly traveling, taking their performances from one town to the next; you learned to assist them at an early age.

Benefit: You gain a +1 trait bonus to Perform (any one) and Knowledge (geography) and one of these (your choice) is always a class skill for you.
